# Findings — best sustain + damage build for teamfights

*Generated by `scripts/findings.py` from the solver output. Patch baseline: Minor Update 09-16-2026 (still live on 2026-09-25).*

## Answer

**Drifter** is the strongest teamfight sustain + damage pick in the model (stage-weighted teamfight score **2.919**, ahead of Warden 2.438 and Viscous 1.950). It ranks #1 at 32k and #1 at 50k.

All-round #1 (15% picks, 30% skirmish, 55% teamfight): **Drifter** (4.100).

## Benchmark: Enemy Drifter from your match — 21 / 2 / 17, 93k player damage, 36k healing

Scoreboard at 57k net worth. The 11 item icons were matched against the official shop art (correlation 0.70–0.95 each). It spends only 33.6k of 57k on items. It is a pick / stealth tempo build (Veil Walker invisibility, Stalker reveal, Kinetic Dash, Trophy Collector snowball): it wins by choosing fights, which this sustained-combat model does not price. In a drawn-out teamfight the model rates it far below a lifesteal + shred build.

## What was wrong before (fixed 2026-09-25)

- Drifter's rows were hand-overwritten by `apply_all_drifter_fixes.py`: a 16-item build, a 64,000-soul budget (everyone else 50,000) and one easy scenario instead of the five-scenario ensemble. `verify/check_outputs.py` failed on the published data.
- Slot rules: the game has 12 universal slots (9 + 3 from Walkers); the model used 16 with 4/4/4 + 4 flex.
- Drifter-only hacks: a 7 m engagement range for Drifter alone, and Bloodscent's +15/26% isolated-target amp applied to every target in every teamfight. Isolation now only applies to picks, some skirmishes and Eternal Night's uptime.
- Extractor dropped untyped tooltip sections and `elevated_properties`, so conditional buffs (Burst Fire +32% fire rate, Stalker, Healing Tempo) were counted as always on.
- Escalating Resilience was 51% bullet resist (stacks × 2% × 0.85); the wiki cap is 30%.
- Golden Goose Egg's and Cursed Relic's penalty on YOUR damage was treated as a debuff on enemies.
- Self-drain (Blood Tribute) was clamped away whenever healing was low.
- ~25 item damage procs (Mystic Shot, Tesla, Toxic Bullets, Spirit Burn, Torment Pulse, Mercurial Magnum, …) and enemy debuffs (Juggernaut, Hunter's Aura, Suppressor, Rusted Barrel) were ignored.
- The reference opponent's resist shred never applied to you, so resist was overvalued for every hero; its DPS also omitted procs, bleeds and Siphon.
- Healing could cancel 92% of incoming damage (8% floor), which produced 'unkillable' 53× scores. The floor is now 25%.
- Cooldowns were averaged over a whole game (Vampiric Burst 17% uptime, Eternal Night 6%), undervaluing actives, ultimates and burst kits. Each scenario is now one 20-second engagement entered with every cooldown ready.
- Weapon/Spirit Shielding's 18% resist was permanent; it only lasts the 8 s barrier (05-22-2026 patch).
- Mercurial Magnum's per-bullet bonus is '+20% Base Bullet Damage' in the game files, not flat damage; read as flat it gave fast-firing heroes (Bebop) ~976 DPS and put it in every build.
- Ability scale types were ignored: per-boon (Venator's Ira Domini) and melee-scaled (Silver's Boot Kick) coefficients were multiplied by Spirit Power, and Graves' Spirit Power buff counted as damage.
- Early game had 12 slots; you start with 9 and gain one per enemy Walker. Builds and purchase orders now respect 9 / 10 / 11 / 12 slots by net worth.
- The website carried a second JavaScript copy of the model (with the same hacks) and the Heroes and Items tabs were broken (`renderHero` / `renderItems` did not exist).

## Model

| scenario | all-round weight | teamfight weight | focus | anti-heal | bullet share | isolated |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| pick | 15% | 0% | 1.0× | 20% | 65% | 100% |
| skirmish | 30% | 0% | 1.6× | 35% | 60% | 25% |
| teamfight | 35% | 60% | 2.4× | 50% | 55% | 0% |
| bullet_team | 10% | 20% | 2.2× | 40% | 80% | 0% |
| spirit_team | 10% | 20% | 2.2× | 40% | 30% | 0% |

Search: greedy x3 + exhaustive add/drop/swap climb + 24-round iterated local search; reference-opponent drift per pass 31.8% → 18.1% → 6.8%; runtime 9.5 min. Every build is re-verified as a one-exchange local optimum by `verify/check_outputs.py --deep`.

Not modelled: crowd control, mobility, objectives, farming, vision, team composition, player skill, melee routing and resource-gated abilities. Treat the cross-hero order as a combat ranking, not a universal tier list.
